endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP cancellation for L1 signing. Supply action type twapCancel, asset ID a, and TWAP ID t. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 for an unknown, cancelled or filled TWAP, or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a pUSD withdrawal batch to the bridge routing address. `recipientAddr` defaults to the signer and is echoed in `plan.plan.details.recipient`; check it before signing. 422 when the asset is not on the bridge's list or the amount is under its minimum (2 pUSD for USDC on Base), since the bridge never delivers smaller transfers. On submit, `final` means the pUSD reached the bridge; delivery to the destination chain takes minutes.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deploy the deposit wallet, then add its missing trading approvals, one step per call. Requires the signer's `credentialToken` (401 once revoked). Undeployed: `plan.plan.details.step` is "deploy"; the wallet signs and POSTs the action to /predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit, then calls again (202 while pending). Deployed: a Batch of the missing approvals for the same route. 422 "Nothing to onboard" is not charged; GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer} checks for free.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch redeeming resolved positions to pUSD; `conditionId` narrows it to one condition. `plan.plan.details.conditions` lists what this batch redeems. Protocol V2 positions go in a batch of their own: when CTF positions are redeemable too, this batch carries those and `plan.plan.details.pendingConditions` lists the V2 conditions for the next prepare. V2 outcomes that pay nothing are skipped. 422 when nothing is redeemable.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Trade and settlement history of a venue account, newest first and cursor-paged: fills (TRADE, with the pUSD that actually moved, fees included), REDEEM, SPLIT/MERGE, CONVERSION and rewards, each with its Polygon transaction hash. Deposits and withdrawals appear only when `type` names them. To page, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same filters. The ground truth after an ambiguous submit. Errors: 400 invalid filter, 422 cursor or filters refused by the venue, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch moving native USDC held by the deposit wallet to the bridge (credited as pUSD). Only for USDC already in the deposit wallet: the normal path is sending USDC to the bridge deposit addresses from GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer}, which needs no batch. The chainhilt wallet signs `response.actions[0]`, a Batch, and POSTs it to /predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit. Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 balance or bridge minimum (not charged), 429 daily relayer cap.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Construct a prediction-market order; never submits. Needs a `credentialToken` from /predict/polymarket/credentials. Returns `construction` and a signature action the chainhilt wallet signs and POSTs to /predict/polymarket/orders/submit. Review orderSummary and warnings before signing: `estimatedBuilderFee` (ours) and `estimatedVenueFee` (Polymarket's) are pUSD on top of the principal. Errors: 400 invalid input, 401 invalid credentialToken, 422 order refused, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deterministic prediction-market quote from the live order book: integer micro-unit book walk (buys round principal up, sells round proceeds down). `estimatedVenueFee` is Polymarket's own taker fee at the average price (shares × rate × p × (1 − p), from the market's live fee schedule; null when the venue reports a fee type this API cannot price). Informational only — nothing is reserved. Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 untradable market, wrong token or thin book, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prediction market detail: resolution rules, outcomes with their tokenIds, tick size, fees and the raw venue payload. Errors: 400 invalid id, 422 unknown market, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel-all action the user must sign; it cancels the account's open orders on the default perp DEX and spot, but not on builder-deployed perp DEXs. Errors: 400 invalid input or no open orders, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Held outcome-token positions with PnL and redeemability. Live positions from the venue's public data feed: size, average/current price, cash and realized PnL, and whether each position is redeemable (market resolved). Redemption itself is an on-chain action from the holding wallet; resolved positions redeem to pUSD. `truncated: true` means the upstream page cap was hit and more positions exist. Errors: 400 invalid address or filter, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Live order book for each outcome of a prediction market: bids and asks (price, size) per outcome tokenId, read from the venue at `observedAt`. Check depth and spread here before quoting or constructing an order. A closed or untradable market returns 422, which is not charged.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Search prediction markets. `closingAfter`/`closingBefore` bound the venue query; other filters apply after fetching `limit` rows, so a page can be short or empty while `nextCursor` is set: keep paging until it is absent. `sort=closingTime` lists open markets closing soonest; with `closingBefore` it finds short-horizon markets such as the 5-minute crypto up/down slots, which text `query` search never returns. Errors: 400 invalid query or cursor, 502 venue failure.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: An event and every market under it. The venue's grouping of markets: every line of a match, or the mutually exclusive outcomes of a multi-outcome question (`negRisk: true` means exactly one of them resolves Yes). Markets come back in the search-result shape (outcome tokenIds, tradability, fees), each with the venue's short `label` when it has one. Reach an event from any market's `eventId`; an unknown id is a 422.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Select the best available swap quote and return ordered unsigned transaction actions. Run the returned actions in order: up to two approvals, then the swap. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 when no connector quotes or the swap cannot be built.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare an order for L1 signing with the configured lowercase builder and fee in tenths of a basis point. Sign and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input, 409 builder approval slots full, 428 builder fee not yet approved (sign the returned approval, then retry), 502 provider failure, 503 builder not configured. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a USDC-only withdrawal to the signing account; other assets return 400. Unified account and portfolio margin accounts must use spot; manual mode may use spot or perp. Arbitrum receives the amount less a fee, and gas comes from the balance left, so the whole balance cannot be withdrawn. Sign the typedData and submit it unchanged to submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return the Hyperliquid noop action the user must sign to mark a nonce as used for safer in-flight cancellation workflows. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel action the user must sign for an open numeric order ID. Errors: 400 invalid input or no matching open order, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed abstraction change: disabled, unifiedAccount, or portfolioMargin. Sign with the owner's wallet and submit to the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a single-order modification by OID or CLOID for L1 signing. Supply the full replacement order. Omit action.a unless true. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. See /skills.md for signing rules. Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP order for L1 signing. Estimated total value at the current mid must be at least $100 for perps or 100 of the pair's quote token for spot; builder-deployed perps are not supported. Sign and submit using the returned submitPath. Errors: 400 invalid input, unknown asset or value under the minimum, 502 provider failure; execution may return 422 exchange rejection. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Produce an agent-ready Hyperliquid portfolio report covering equity, PnL, leverage, margin health, liquidation exposure, and concentration. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return chart-ready Hyperliquid portfolio graph data for account value, PnL, drawdown, deposits, and withdrawals. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Detect high leverage, liquidation proximity, concentration, funding drag, and missing stops for a Hyperliquid account. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview a Hyperliquid trade with notional, margin impact, slippage, liquidation estimate, exchange fees, and builder fee. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed sendAsset transfer between users, subaccounts, spot and perp DEXs. Use "" for the default perp DEX and "spot" for spot; perp transfers require the collateral token. Sign with the main wallet and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Invalid input returns 400; execution may return 422 for rejection or 502 for provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Audit Hyperliquid open orders for stale, duplicate, conflicting, reduce-only, or unprotected orders. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Compare bridge routes, best first: tokens, estimated and minimum target amounts, fees by token, duration, expiry and the approval each route needs. sourceAmount is exactly what leaves the wallet. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 when no adapter returns a route.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare the selected bridge route as ordered unsigned transactions: an exact-amount ERC-20 approval when needed (after an approval to 0 for tokens like Ethereum USDT), then the bridge transaction. Pass the minTargetAmount and maxNativeFee the user accepted; if the fresh quote delivers less or charges more native fee, it returns 409 with quote { adapter, estimatedTargetAmount, minTargetAmount, nativeFee } and no actions. Send the actions before expiresAt.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Look up a bridge after its transaction was sent, by the adapter that built it and the hash of the bridge transaction on the source chain; layerzero and relay also need the providerRef that bridge/execute returned (0x and 64 hex characters). Poll it every 10 to 15 seconds until the status is filled, refunded or failed; an error answer, such as a 429, is not charged. After a 429, wait the Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Resolve an order asset ID from asset (symbol, spot pair, @index, or numeric market index) and sourceDex ("" for default perps, "spot" for spot). Spot IDs are 10000 + spot market index; already formatted IDs are preserved. Token indexes are not market indexes. Unknown or ambiguous assets return 400; provider failures return 502. Use assetId as orders[].a or modify order.a before signing. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Add or remove isolated margin for a perp asset. ntli is a signed integer in millionths of USD: 1000000 adds 1 USD; -1000000 removes 1 USD. isBuy defaults to true. Sign and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Set cross or isolated leverage for a perp asset. Supply isCross and positive integer leverage; market limits apply. Sign the L1 preview and submit it unchanged to the returned submitPath (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input; execution may return 422 exchange rejection or 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

Pass address (0x or an ENS name like vitalik.eth, resolved on Ethereum) and optional chains. Exact on-chain amounts with block numbers; a chain that fails is listed in errors, never shown as zero. No USD prices. $0.003 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a DEX swap quote with a ready unsigned transaction: best route from Velora (ParaSwap), KyberSwap as fallback, on Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Input: chain, from, to (symbol or address), amount in base units, taker. Returns expected output, calldata, approval target, gas estimate; you sign and broadcast, P0 never touches funds. A 0.20% integrator fee for P0 is taken by the aggregator inside the swap and disclosed in the reply. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for reading a web page as clean markdown for an LLM or agent (url to markdown, reader, html to text): POST {url, max_chars} and get {title, markdown, chars, source_url}. One fetch of a public http/https page on request (no JavaScript rendering), robots.txt respected, 2 MB/8 s caps; headings, links, lists, code, tables kept; up to 20,000 chars. Rule-based, no AI summary. $0.005 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days, with min, max, mean and percent change. Statistics are calculated by P0; a stale flag marks old data. Source attribution in every reply. For information only, not transaction rates. ECB data is available free of charge on the ECB website. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for euro exchange rates: ECB reference rates or cross rates via EUR (optional base, symbols, amount, date) with change versus the previous publication (calculated by P0) and a stale flag. Source attribution in every reply. For information only, not transaction rates. ECB data is available free of charge on the ECB website. Not charged if data is unavailable or input invalid. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for debugging an x402 client: pay $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network in accepts and get back what the server received: the decoded payment payload (scheme, network, authorization fields, signature), checks of amount, payTo, asset and validity window against this route's requirement, and the facilitator's settlement result. Only the payment header is echoed, never other headers.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for testing that your x402 client can pay and settle a real payment end to end at the smallest useful price: $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network listed in accepts. Returns the settlement receipt: ok, timestamp, network, payer address, transaction hash, explorer link and the facilitator that settled it. No data product: a health and settlement canary for wallets, agents, SDKs and QA fleets.

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Plainsight
endpoints.description: x402 Route Heat: per-route payment-gap snapshot from the shop's signed records — who knocks on each paid route (unique agents), attempts vs settlements over 30 days, and the gap between them. Where x402 agents actually pay, route by route.

endpoints.name: Plainsight

For builders and operators deciding what to list and at what price. Read from the facilitator's own usage counters.

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Plainsight

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Watch one public page for 7 days. Checks hourly. When the content hash changes, POST {watch_id,url,old_fingerprint,new_fingerprint,changed_at} to your https callback (5s timeout, one retry). POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com","callback_url":"https://example.com/hook"}. Returns {watch_id,url,expires,status_url}. Free status is GET /v1/watch/:id and does not show the callback. At 500 active watches, POST returns 503 before payment. $0.10 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Public-record company profile for a domain: legal name, domain age, registrar, LEI, and social links. Merges homepage Organization JSON-LD, RDAP, GLEIF, and Wikidata. Each filled field names its source. POST JSON {"domain":"coinbase.com"} or {"url":"https://www.coinbase.com"}. Nothing found is HTTP 200 with nulls, not an error. $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Extract schema.org structured data from a public HTML page: JSON-LD (@graph flattened), top-level microdata, and Open Graph / Twitter meta. Normalizes Product/Offer, Article, Organization, Event, FAQ, and breadcrumbs. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com"}. No structured data is HTTP 200 with empty arrays, not an error. Public http(s) only. $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Batch page-meta for 1–10 public URLs in one payment. POST JSON {"urls":["https://example.com"]}. Returns {results:[{url,ok:true,meta}|{url,ok:false,error}]}. Each meta has title, description, canonical, ogImage, language, and a ~500-character excerpt. One URL failing does not fail the batch. $0.15 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Fingerprint a public page so agents can detect changes: final url, etag, lastModified, sha256 contentHash of normalized visible text, raw byteLength, and fetchedAt. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com"}. Public http(s) only; private hosts blocked. $0.04 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Extract the outbound link graph of a public HTML page: final url, title, unique links as {href, text?}, and count. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com","maxLinks":50}. Optional maxLinks is an integer 1–50 (default 50). Skips #, javascript, mailto, tel, and data links. Public http(s) only. $0.03 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Extract the main readable plaintext of a public HTML page: final url, title, text (capped), wordCount, language, and fetchedAt. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com","maxChars":12000}. Optional maxChars is an integer 1–12000 (default 12000). Public http(s) only; private hosts blocked. $0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: Scrooge Tool Mill — x402 pay-per-call APIs for agents
endpoints.description: Extract public HTML page metadata for agents: title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph image, language, and a ~500-character plaintext excerpt. POST JSON {"url":"https://example.com"}. Public http(s) only. $0.002 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). No API key.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Autonomous AI research job: model selects up to three read-only tools and produces an evidence-backed report. Persistent queue, private job token, cooperative cancellation. Settlement only after a valid result. Quotas apply; no paid upgrades.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Public RIR RDAP IP network registration: registered country, network and address range. Not precise city/GPS geolocation; private contacts are not returned.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: OHLCV candlestick history for a crypto pair (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD and others) at hourly, daily or weekly granularity, with the last candle and the percentage change across the window. Use it for price history and trend analysis.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get a plain-language summary of any Wikipedia article, with coordinates for geographic topics. Use it for a quick factual definition of a term, person, place or technology.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search Hacker News stories by keyword over the last day, week or year, with points, comments and links. Use it to find what the developer community is discussing about a technology right now.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a package on npm or PyPI: latest version, description, license, dependency count, keywords and release date. Use it before adding a dependency, to judge whether a project is maintained and how much it pulls in.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert an amount between currencies using European Central Bank reference rates. Use it for currency conversion, to price something in another currency, or to check the current rate.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Geocode a place name, address or landmark into latitude and longitude, with country and city. Use it to turn a location into coordinates, to locate a place, or to get context for where something is.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: MET Norway forecast for coordinates, with 3-day coverage, temperature, wind and humidity. Licensed CC BY 4.0 / NLOD, cached with attribution. Forecast, not instrument observation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. Use it as a supply-chain check: given a package and a version, say whether installing it would bring in a known CVE, and which version fixes it.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: WHOIS and RDAP lookup for a domain: is it registered or AVAILABLE for purchase, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and status codes. Use it to check whether a domain name is free before buying it, to find when one expires, or to read ownership and nameserver details.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trending GitHub repositories for a daily, weekly or monthly window, with stars, primary language and description. Use it to see what developers are shipping right now, to scout new libraries, or to find examples of a technique.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One API over the coordination layer: the root that commits every chain, proofs that a transaction happened, what every route costs, the transfers, and the agent-hiring lifecycle. Most operations are public reads. Writes say who may make them in `security` (RelayerKey = X-API-Key, OperatorToken = x-operator-token) and in x-taifoon-auth.rule; nothing here signs or sends a transaction for you. A 2xx JSON object answered to a caller that sent no key also carries `get_key` (and the headers x-taifoon-get-key and Link rel=free-key): how to get a free key in one call; proofs, evidence packs, cards and this document are left as written. Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Enlist an expert of the tenant's product: { expert key:<24hex>, payee (an address, or the expert's key ref until it claims one), chains, share_bps ≤ 7000, cap per period, classes } → a nomination sma.nomination.v1 in state proposed; the expert POSTs { id, accept: true } to accept; the admin POSTs { id, revoke: true } to revoke.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Close the loop on a case: answer it (words, by an expert, an agent or a member), grade it (Jev, the buyer or the admin), or tune a loop of the tenant inside its bounds (admin only). A graded answer becomes a fix node and a fixed_by edge; the provider leg goes to the answerer's nominated payee; the meter line is written.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The product's knowledge graph as the helpdesk holds it (?product=<id>, ?scope=public|product|tenant, ?weakest=1 for the ranked unknowns): nodes { id, kind, scope, label, confidence, asked, learned_from }, edges { from, to, kind, weight }, open { category, license, weights, source }.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Show Me Around ++ the helpdesk (_SMA_HELPDESK_v1_, lang/cue/sma-helpdesk.cue): one question about one product → a case. The product's graph answers first (free, measured); an unknown is routed to a nominated expert, the tenant's agent or a person; every answer is graded before it is settled as one sma.case line (0.10 USDC above the free allowance of 20 a day per key; legs provider 70 · graders 20 · ecosystem 10); the trail is sealed under the tenant's topic helpdesk.<name>, read by nobody but th

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's state per chain in the Prometheus text format (_DESK_METRICS_v1_), to scrape into an exchange's own monitoring; ?format=json for JSON.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: State proof of an account at a final block (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): its nonce and native balance, and one ERC-20 balance by its slot; an address with no account is proven absent.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Completeness proof over final blocks (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): every ERC-20 transfer to (in) or from (out) an address in a range, and a proof there is no other; NONE proves absence.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Membership proof of one EVM transaction (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): it is in a final block under the superroot, who signed it, and exactly which ERC-20 transfers it moved; the bundle verifies offline.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The deposit lambda registry: the built-in lambdas (evm, tron, substrate) and the third-party manifests (data only), each with its family, chains, finality, hash and whether a reader exists.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_deposits lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the deposits to watched addresses: each transfer once per level it reaches (seen, confirmed, final), resumable by Last-Event-ID.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_finality lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the desk chains' finality: finalized each time a chain's final block moves, halt and resume from its health (fail closed); every event id is the resume cursor.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: A sent withdrawal: DELIVERED once it succeeded in a final block, else NOT_YET (terminal when it reverted), with the proof link.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: May a withdrawal go out now: SEND or HOLD with the reason and the best node (the rotation's nodes asked their head now). Nothing is broadcast.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The deposits to an address over a block window, as common deposit records with their level (EVM and Tron tokens up to 2,000 blocks a call).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One transaction as a deposit: CREDIT, WAIT or REJECT with the reason, the common deposit records (taifoon.deposit.v1) and the evidence; fail closed (unreadable is WAIT).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's chains (_DESK_API_v1_): every chain the desk serves with its family (evm, tron, substrate), CAIP-2 id, finality rule, sources and health, and what a desk should do now.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record a batch-judge outcome for the coordination layer (relayer key required).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Grade up to 4 items with ONE calibrated call — each item’s full distribution kept.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The on-chain judge result, live: every ERC-8183 event of a job with its transaction and explorer link, the deterministic ending, and Jev’s three-field answer beside it.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The evidence Jev reads about one job the observatory keys — an ERC-8183 / memo-ACP job, an extra deployment’s job, or an assurance-hook job by its 32-byte id (the layer’s hook or Moonbeam ACP’s): task, price, parties, the timeline with the deadline, how it ended, the seller’s record and this buyer’s history with this seller, plus what is not known.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The evidence pack for one Olas Mech marketplace request on Base — the public prompt, tool, mech, fee and response.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One A2A Registry agent as a hirer needs it: its own record, whether it is open, its dialect, a live card probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: HashProof, an ERC-8004 agent on Celo, for discovery: the ERC-8004 agents that publish its MCP endpoint, and credentials in its CredentialRegistry on Celo, read on chain in one batch (_CELO_8004_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Nevermined’s agent services catalogue for discovery: every service, its protocol, price, network and health. Calling one needs a Nevermined key (blocked).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Skyfire’s service directory for discovery: every service, its type, price and seller. Calling one needs a Skyfire buyer key (blocked).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The A2A Registry (a2aregistry.org) for discovery: agents with the URL their card publishes, the A2A dialect, whether it is free to call, the registry’s own health checks, a live card probe, and ERC-8004 cross-links (_A2A_REGISTRY_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Coinbase AgentKit workers registered with the layer: the release, its action providers, the actions each serves, a live probe (_AGENTKIT_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The auto-match loop records the next step of a demand (open → claimed → matched → hired → graded → settling → settled; unmatched / failed end it).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Post what a buyer agent needs, not whom to hire: in words ({ need }) or as a job of a class the auto-match loop runs (mcp.digest, a2a.json_normalize, stats.describe, chat.word_count, credential.verify.celo, agentkit.erc20_transfer, transfer.attest.cctp, typed.compile, tee.typed.compile). Words are mapped to a class by deterministic rules and the catalogue, never a model (_DEMAND_NEED_v1_). The layer’s loop claims the demand, picks the seller with SELLER_CHOICE_v3, hires it through the broker, ch

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Publish the network snapshot (the hourly auto-connect run).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What the community hits: the refusal codes outside callers met most often on /v1 over the last 7 UTC days, from the access log's refusal counters. Counts only: no address, key or caller (_CLI_TROUBLESHOOT_v1_; the page taifoon.io/cli links each code to its fix).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The /v1/metrics headline per UTC day for charts, Taifoon’s own vs customers, oldest first (_COORD_METRICS_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: How much went through the coordination layer on one day, in one read: calls per route and key class, handshakes by protocol, gateway λ steps by kind, hires settled, grades, bridges (n, volume, fee), the evaluator fee, grade purchases, agents onboarded, resources listed and unique callers — per chain, split Taifoon’s own (its keys, its servers, wallets in the address registry, devnet test keys) vs customers, each labelled on-chain or off-chain (_COORD_METRICS_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The gateway counters, the feed /v1/metrics reads for calls through the gateway: in total, per resource, per JSON-RPC method, per ending state and per day (off-chain).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One recorded gateway call (taifoon.step.v1): the λ path, the digests of the request and the answer, and the step digest recomputed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record one probe the layer made itself as a λ step (_AUTOCONNECT_v1_): a warmbed rotation read (rpc), a cross-chain quote (route), an A2A card, a uAgent record, an unpaid 402. MCP sellers are probed through /gw/mcp and recorded there.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The resources the drop-in gateways serve: point a stock MCP client at the resource’s gateway URL instead of its own endpoint, and every call is forwarded unchanged, recorded as a λ step and counted (_LAMBDA_GW_MCP_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One MCP registry server as a hirer needs it: its own record, the open endpoint, a live probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The resale wall of one class, probed with GET: the x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) without a body, or the answer with the input as query parameters and a payment (_X402_GET_WALL_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The x402 Bazaar for discovery: resources paid through the CDP facilitator, each a payable row with its prices and readiness; nothing is paid (_X402_BAZAAR_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The official MCP registry for discovery: servers with the endpoint they published, whether it is free to call, a live probe, and ERC-8004 cross-links (_MCP_REGISTRY_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One Fetch.ai agent as a hirer needs it: its own Almanac record and the request models its protocols declare.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Fetch.ai Agentverse agents from its own public search: address, hosting type, protocols, interactions (_AGENTVERSE_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Olas Mech marketplace on every chain it runs on (Gnosis, Base, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Robinhood Chain) in one read: every mech with its chain, how it is paid, its card with each tool’s input/output schema, which tools actually answer, and its ERC-8004 agent id.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
